facts.statement: A daily special Festival of Hearts prize wheel gives bonus prizes.
facts.quote: There is a daily prize wheel

article_summaries.title: The Festival of Hearts Has Begun!
article_summaries.summary: SOE's in-game news post announcing the annual Festival of Hearts in Merry Vale, retelling the Rylan and Arianna legend and the villain Stone Heart. It lists festival offerings (daily prize wheel, daily and Members Only quests, TCG bundles, new pets, Station Cash and Coin Shop items) and how to reach the festival via the Merry Vale Warpstone. The post gives no dates, prices or quest details.
